environment.execution: One benchmark process at a time; affinity/power/background load uncontrolled; filesystem/import caches may be OS-warm; no cross-host comparison.

conditions.geometry: 80 columns, max(8, count) rows; 256 rows is synthetic stress.
conditions.clock: Virtual deadlines; perf_counter_ns measures actual elapsed computation. No real sleeps.
conditions.output: Initial and real completion output excluded from active counters; virtual sink retains bounded test frames.
conditions.limits: No real 4 ms wall-clock enforcement measurement, OS transport, terminal, human input, clipboard, domain operation, Ledger latency or RSS/global heap claim. Source fingerprints identify measured dirty sources. 30/4 Hz frames and 8/2 Hz indicators remain candidates, not calibrated optimal rates.
